question_text: Describe how a firewall applies a rule that blocks unsolicited incoming connections to a research computer.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: It inspects incoming traffic against configured rules. Traffic matching the blocked connection rule is rejected; traffic permitted by other rules may pass. This reduces unauthorized network access but does not remove all malicious content in allowed traffic.
